messages:
Ben: Quick check — procurement sent a shipping update: the 2nd H100 batch moved from 2026-03-28 to 2026-04-12. That shifts the staging canary for slice-2 by ~2 weeks. @Carla can you confirm current reservation counts in us-west-2?

Carla: I saw the alert. Procurement put two shipments on a customs hold. Current state: hard_reserved=24, soft_reserved=24, available=12. I can convert 24 soft -> hard but Finance signoff needed.

Ben: Ok. @Ashley can Finance greenlight pulling contingency to firm up the extra 24 for slice-2? If no, we should plan to reduce canary footprint.

Ashley: I can approve up to $30k from contingency but need a short ticket with line-item costs and expected monthly run-rate. @Sam please drop the numbers here.

Sam: uploading the quick breakdown now — summary: firming 24 slots = ~$28.3k/mo, one-time provisioning buffer ~$4.5k. Link: https://intranet.redwood/procurement/reservation-costs.csv  TL;DR numbers inlined.

Carla: Thanks. Ops note: cluster maintenance (FW roll) for the new racks in us-west-2 is scheduled 2026-04-08 02:00-06:00 PT. Each rack will see ~2h outage during the window. Migrations planned but will temporarily reduce capacity during the morning rollout.

ops-bot: Reminder: 4/08 firmware window added to calendar for namespace: us-west-2-dedicated. See incident page: https://incidents.redwood/4-08-fw

Liam: From runtime side — if procurement slips, we can failover traffic to the quantized A100 variant in the same region (latency + cost tradeoffs). I'll open a small PR to add a routing fallback policy and an automatic capacity gate for the canary. That should keep customer SLOs while we wait.

Ben: Nice. Quick checklist so we don't lose follow-ups:
- Carla -> confirm whether you can convert 24 soft to hard by EOD Tue (3332110000).
- Ashley -> approve contingency and comment on the ticket (Sam to add numbers).
- Sam -> attach the cost ticket and set the monthly cadence numbers.
- Liam -> PR for fallback routing + gating rules before the next deploy window.

Carla: Will update the thread after I hear back from procurement/legal on the customs hold. If customs doesn't clear by 4/05 we should treat 4/12 as optimistic.

Ashley: I'll tentatively approve pending the ticket, ping me once Sam attaches the CSV.

Sam: Done — ticket #PR-4589 created and linked in the spreadsheet.

Ben: Thanks all. One more quick debug/check command for visibility if someone needs to snap the pool state:
```
reservation-cli show --pool slice-2
# output
pool: slice-2
hard_reserved: 24
soft_reserved: 24
available: 12
status: partial
```

Ben: If procurement changes again, I'll re-run the rollout plan. For now we hold canary scheduling until Carla confirms hard reservation or we get Finance approval. :thumbsup:
